decisions.reason: A burner component that builds on the core radiant-heater business costs little to carry, and a growing firm with slack has no shortfall that would prompt it to search for other uses of the resources.
This flagship electric infrared panel line has its own page and fits the firm's electrification direction, so a growing firm with ample slack will keep it while its results mature.
The halogen heater is a peripheral single product with some risk of being consolidated, but in an expanding firm there is no performance pressure strong enough to prompt dropping it.
The industrial electric hall heater line sits close to the core hall-heating business and is featured on its own page, so its results are likely satisfactory and it stays.
The hydrogen-capable flagship line went into real operation at a customer site and embodies the firm's low-carbon strategy, so its strong legitimacy and the firm's slack make keeping it very likely.
